The '''Coporation of Vurahi''', officially and legally the '''Mayor and Commonalty and Citizens of Vurahi,''' is the local authority [[Vurahi]], located in the historic centre of [[Vurahi]] and the location of much of the [[Areoix Lie|Areoix Lies]] financial sector until the 16th century when The company was disbanded. Due to economic reforms coupled with the Finical Capital moving to [[Zirohu]]
